mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate consistently signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or win rate < 55% when FEDFUNDS < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Win rate < 55% for negative 60-day SPX returns when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window in high inflation regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or win rate < 55% when PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 thousand units signals weak residential construction and declining consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a monetary tightening cycle that simultaneously increases borrowing costs and weakens labor markets, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market stress
failure_condition: Win rate < 55% for negative 20-day SPX returns when both FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong industrial production (INDPRO > 115), manufacturing activity is robust, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 115, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window in strong manufacturing regimes.
